name: Zohra Tajuddin
contribution: Syeda Zohra Tajuddin was an Awami League organiser who helped preserve the party’s continuity after the 1975 assassination of its senior leadership.
context: As Tajuddin Ahmad’s political partner and later a party leader in her own right, she worked to keep democratic and liberation-war commitments present in public politics.
impact: Her career shows the often-underrecorded organisational labour through which political movements survive crisis.
